children: Goldman Sachs on Monday forecast a 25-basis-point Bank of England rate hike in November this year, saying persistent inflation pressures and resilient economic growth strengthen the case for tighter policy.
The brokerage had previously expected the Bank of England to keep interest rates unchanged throughout 2026.
